title: 第7章 惨遭噬阳刚激活的灵体没了第8章 我和圣洁美女双修被她师门追杀
content_zh:
子琼详细给我们解释了“阴阳调息”的原理。
原来“阴阳调息”又叫“五行阴阳调息”。
核心是借助阴阳之力、五行相生，弥补灵体本源的先天不足。
简单说，就是激活灵体！
我终于能拥有土灵体，成为真正的修炼者！
子琼是神木星人，按道理本该天生激活双属性灵体，可她只激活了木灵体。
为了激活缺失的灵体，她做了数万年研究，才终于找到了“阴阳调息”这门功法。
“阴阳调息”需要一对阴阳契合、五行同属性的伴侣当核心，才能为另外四人激活不同五行属性的灵体。
金瑾、敏珉、禾合、莘馨和我，恰好天生分别缺少金、水、木、火、土灵体。
馥蜜拥有土灵体，还和我阴阳契合。
通过“阴阳调息”，馥蜜可以以我为媒介，按五行相生的顺序，为我和金瑾她们激活对应的灵体。
激活灵体后，我们六人会形成完美的阴阳契合，称之为阴阳双修伴侣，简称阴阳伴侣。
唯一的约束是，从此我们六人永远不能分离，否则六人的灵体都会同时溃散。
激活过程中，我和馥蜜必须紧密配合、全神贯注，绝对不能陷入意乱情迷。
不然的话，我们六人都可能当场走火入魔。
这也难怪昨晚馥蜜急着要与我“适应”，还特意选了“极乐无极神功”。
金瑾她们把这些要求告诉她时，可把她愁坏了。
还好我的“翌恒调息”力挽狂澜，让我即便身处**的狂风暴浪，心神也能岿然不动。
金瑾她们早就入学了，筹备了几万年，就是在等我和馥蜜出现。
要找到合适的“我”，确实太难了。

首先得找到能被阴阳本源晶石认可的阴阳契合伴侣，这就刷掉了绝大多数组合；
其次要求男方没有激活灵体，而这样的男人，根本没勇气来阴阳研究学院；
最后还要求这对伴侣能够“适应”，否则激活时极易走火入魔。
……
激活的方法并不复杂。
简单说，就是连通所有人的任督二脉，形成交叉共循环：
我作为阵眼，在中间打坐；
身前怀抱一人，面对面任脉相贴，阴阳交融；
身后一人与我背靠背打坐，督脉相贴；
头顶一人头冲下倒立，与我百会穴相贴，连通任督二脉；
身下一人同样头冲下倒立，与我连通任督二脉；
馥蜜在我身前，与我双掌对接，连通经脉。
我前后上下的四人要调换四次位置，按土生金、金生水、水生木、木生火的顺序，依次在我身前与我阴阳契合；
四次调换后，我们五人由阴阳契合转为五行契合；
再经过四次调换，在我身前位置完成灵体激活；
最后，她们一起帮我激活土灵体。
为了维持状态稳定，我们可以选择漂浮在水中，或是去太空的失重环境。
金瑾她们还没有灵体，没法“辟谷”，最后我们决定坐飞船去太空激活。
出发前，子琼建议我们先“适应适应”，避免激活时临时磨合出问题。
我依然选择用“极乐无极神功”来适应，有“翌恒调息”把控，全程只觉舒爽，没有丝毫失控。

最后，金瑾、敏珉、禾合、莘馨也都爱上了“极乐无极神功”的妙处。
出发前她们开了个小会，没让我参加，可把我急坏了。
一想到马上就能拥有灵体，我恨不得立刻直飞冲天！
……
飞船终于出发，进入了玄木星的同步轨道。
content_en:
Ziqiong explained to us in detail the principle of "yin and yang breath regulation".
It turns out that "Yin-Yang Breath Regulation" is also called "Five Elements Yin-Yang Breath Regulation".
The core is to use the power of yin and yang and the interplay of the five elements to make up for the innate shortcomings of the spiritual body.
To put it simply, it is to activate the spirit body!
I can finally have an earth spirit body and become a true cultivator!
Zi Qiong is from the Divine Jupiter, so she should have been born with the ability to activate a dual-attribute spirit body, but she only activated the wood spirit body.
In order to activate the missing spirit body, she did tens of thousands of years of research before finally finding the "Yin-Yang Breath Regulation" technique.
"Yin-Yang Breathing Adjustment" requires a pair of partners with Yin-Yang and the same five-element attributes as the core, so that spiritual bodies with different five-element attributes can be activated for the other four people.
Jin Jin, Min Min, He He, Xin Xin and I happened to be born lacking the spiritual bodies of metal, water, wood, fire and earth respectively.
Fumi has an earth spirit body, and her yin and yang are in harmony with me.
Through "yin and yang breath regulation", Fumi can use me as the medium to activate the corresponding spiritual bodies for me and Jin Jin in the order of the five elements.
After activating the spirit body, the six of us will form a perfect yin and yang fit, which is called a yin and yang dual cultivation partner, or a yin and yang partner for short.
The only constraint is that from now on, the six of us can never be separated, otherwise the spirits of all six of us will collapse at the same time.
During the activation process, Fumi and I must cooperate closely and concentrate, and we must not fall into confusion.
Otherwise, all six of us might go crazy on the spot.
It’s no wonder that Fumi was so anxious to “adapt” to me last night that she specially chose the “Bliss Wuji Magical Skill”.
When Jin Jin and the others told her these requirements, she was very worried.
Fortunately, my "Yi Heng Breath Adjustment" turned the tide and allowed me to remain calm even in the violent storm.
Jin Jin and the others have enrolled in school a long time ago and have been preparing for tens of thousands of years, just waiting for Fumi and I to show up.
It is indeed too difficult to find the right "me".
First, you have to find a yin-yang compatible partner that can be recognized by the yin-yang origin crystal, which eliminates most combinations;
Secondly, it is required that the man has not activated his spirit body, and such a man would not have the courage to come to Yin Yang Research Institute;
Finally, the couple is required to be able to "adapt", otherwise it will be easy to go crazy when activated.
…
The activation method is not complicated.
Simply put, it is the two meridians of Ren and Du that connect everyone, forming a cross-circulation:
As the center of the formation, I meditate in the middle;
Holding a person in front of you, face to face with each other's pulse, yin and yang blending together;
There is a person behind me meditating back to back, with the Du Vein touching each other;
The top of the head is standing upside down, touching my Baihui point, connecting the two meridians of Ren and Du;
The person below me also stood on my head with my head down, connecting with me the Ren and Du meridians;
The sweet honey is in front of me, connecting with my palms and connecting the meridians.
The four people in front of me and above me must change their positions four times, and in the order of earth producing metal, metal producing water, water producing wood, and wood producing fire, they must align with my yin and yang in front of me;
After four exchanges, the five of us shifted from the yin-yang fit to the five-element fit;
After four more exchanges, the spiritual body was activated in front of me;
Finally, they helped me activate the earth spirit body together.
In order to maintain a stable state, we can choose to float in the water or go to the weightless environment of space.
Jin Jin and the others didn’t have spiritual bodies yet, so they couldn’t “die”. Finally, we decided to take a spaceship to space to activate them.
Before setting off, Ziqiong suggested that we "get used to it" first to avoid temporary running-in problems during activation.
I still chose to use the "Bliss Wuji Magical Skill" to adapt, and with the "Next Constant Breath Adjustment" to control it, I felt comfortable throughout the whole process, without any loss of control.
Finally, Jin Jin, Min Min, He He, and Xin Xin also fell in love with the wonders of "Bliss Wuji Magic".
They held a small meeting before departure, but I was not allowed to attend, but it made me anxious.
When I think about having a spiritual body right away, I want to fly straight to the sky!
…
The spacecraft finally set off and entered the synchronous orbit of Xuan Jupiter.
